limitations: WebFetch tool failed for all 3 attempted URLs ('proxy refused the connection') — all evidence in this run is based on WebSearch result snippets/summaries rather than fully fetched and verified source pages; claims are labeled accordingly and evidence_type is capped at STRONG_INDIRECT or WEAK where full-page verification was not possible.

Search budget (10 queries) was fully used on breadth across 9 thematic areas (Expo 2030, World Cup 2034, SDAIA AI regulation, SAMA open banking, family business succession, EV adoption, healthcare privatization/CHI, female workforce/childcare, tourism/DMC shortage); no queries were run in Arabic due to budget constraints, which may have missed Arabic-language complaint threads or local forum discussion that would strengthen pain evidence.

No direct evidence was found for existing local competitors/tools in most areas (SDAIA AI compliance tooling, CHI comparison tools, childcare marketplace, family business governance SaaS, EV charger app) — absence of evidence is not proof of absence of competitors; a dedicated competitor search per opportunity was not possible within budget.

All Saudi-specific statistics (participation rates, room counts, charger counts, succession-plan percentages) were taken from single search-snippet sources without independent cross-verification against a second source, due to fetch failures preventing deeper verification.

None of the 9 signals could be confirmed with payment/willingness-to-pay evidence — all are genuinely forward-looking (FUTURE_HYPOTHESIS) inferences from documented regulatory/demographic/infrastructure trends, per the agent's mandate.
